content: If a Job List is configured for a Tx L-PDU (see CanIfT- TJoblist ), a function call of CanIf_Transmit() (see SWS_CanIf_00318 ) shall not directly call Can_Write() . The information that a call of CanIf_Transmit() occurred has to be buffered within TtcanIf until the data is transmitted by the Job List .
